name: NameRobot
summary: Naming tools for companies and products: a toolbox of 100+ name generators, an AI naming assistant, and paid NameScore reports that check availability, trademarks and the sound of a name.
best_for: founders, agencies and marketers naming a company or product who want generators plus a paid availability and sound check per name, without a subscription
skip_if: you need full legal trademark clearance, or you only want a quick list of free name ideas with no checks
honest_knock: NameScore prices are shown as offers against regular prices twice as high, with no end date, and the Naming Toolbox premium price is not printed on namerobot.com. The automated trademark and availability checks are a screening, not legal clearance. NameScore is sold for commercial use and prices exclude VAT, which EU buyers without a VAT ID pay on top. We tested the free start of Namefruits on 22 November 2026 and paid nothing, so the paid name generation and the name checks were not tested. NameRobot's terms (dated 22 July 2021, with the German version legally binding) say the checks are for research only, that NameRobot is not allowed to give legal advice and does not guarantee that a name is free of third-party rights, and that users indemnify NameRobot against claims over names they use. Premium subscriptions renew for the same period unless cancelled in writing or in the account at least two weeks before the term ends.

pricing.entry_price_terms: NameScore, 1 NameReport · one-time, excluding VAT, shown as an offer against a regular $39
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on namerobot.com in a browser render, USD) NameRobot sells several naming tools. NameScore checks a name and returns a NameReport; it is a one-time payment, not a subscription, priced per number of reports, excluding VAT and marked as an offer for commercial use only, each shown against a higher regular price: 1 report $19.00 (regular $39.00), 5 reports $49.00 ($99.00), 10 reports $75.00 ($149.00) and 100 reports $249.00 ($499.00). Namefruits, the AI name generator, is a one-time payment of $99 per naming project, with a free start where you collect words, rate examples and set preferences before paying for full access. The Naming Toolbox, with 100+ name generators and availability checks, is free to try; its premium membership is a subscription whose price is not printed on namerobot.com. Trademarkly, a trademark lookup, is described as free. The payment FAQ lists PayPal, credit card, invoice and SEPA on request, and says EU customers without a VAT ID pay VAT. Re-read on 24 October 2026 with a plain fetch of namerobot.com/NameScore and the Namefruits page: the four NameScore offers and regular prices and the $99 Namefruits project price unchanged. The NameScore page now says flat rates are coming and asks interested buyers to get in touch; no flat-rate price is printed.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in Namefruits, NameRobot's naming app, with the interface in English. We set up a naming project for a software price comparison website, took the free Thorough Mode and chose Keep trying at every payment prompt. We paid nothing.
findings: Sign-up: only an email and a password, with no card. The app opened straight on a questionnaire with a progress counter.
Mode: after about ten questions it asked us to pick Quick Mode, with payment right at the start, or Thorough Mode, with payment only after a few questions. We took Thorough Mode.
Payment prompts: the first came at 7% of the questionnaire and a second at 10%, right where the first name suggestions would start. Neither screen showed a price.
Names: up to that point we got no name for our own project. The Unused Names list said There are no names in this list yet.

Keywords: the free part collected 35 keywords, all derived from the Software industry we picked. Our own description, comparing software prices, did not show up in the list; you can add keywords by hand.
Language: one label on the mode screen was still in German (Zahlung) in the English interface.
not_tested: the paid name generation and the names it makes; namerobot.com listed $99 per project on 7 October 2026
the automatic domain and trademark checks on names, and the NameReport at the end
NameScore and NameReport bought on their own ($19 per report)
the name idea guarantee, which promises a new run for free
